The runtime PM callback is registered **separately** and reached only through the runtime-PM core:

invoked via `pci_dev_pm_ops.runtime_suspend` → `pm->runtime_idle/runtime_suspend` (pci-driver.c:1435). Key points of the hand-off:
1. `kdev` (the PCI device) → `dev_get_drvdata` → `struct drm_device *` → `container_of` on the embedded `drm` member (i915_drv.h:169) → `struct drm_i915_private *` (i.e., `dev_priv`).
